scope: the 8 claim_status='general' occurrences in the five pilot records (production/stage_c/pilot_claude/outputs/)
basis: EXTRACTED PAGE TEXT of the cited physical pages, read in conversation and presented to the reviewer with surrounding context for the two occurrences whose pronoun referent lay outside the quote. NOT a reading of the PDF, and therefore NOT a V1 verification as the verification matrix defines it: V1 is a human opening the cited page. This is weaker and is recorded as what it is.
notes: Two of the eight have an 'empirically demonstrated' twin in the same record -- 472535351 (the paper states that no definitive validation approach exists, citing Law 2022, and then validates its own model and finds the simulated values below the measured ones) and 472536694 (the benchmark-becomes-unrepresentative principle, then demonstrated on the US cement industry). That split is the behaviour the claim_status field was added for.
Three of the eight carry an explicit citation to other literature (McLaughlin et al. 2016; Law 2022), which is the clearest form of 'general'.
Cosmetic, not a classification error: 472535550 K1's quote ends mid-list at 'production mix,'.
